annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Pins init's installs to an embedded version set and warns on skew with a bare `!==`. A user on a newer runtime than the CLI embeds is told to downgrade, and a runtime-only release leaves the CLI's embed stale. The PR's own review flagged the staleness and it was deferred to #669. Latent, acknowledged; no incident recorded.

known_defects.description: Version-skew check has no direction; newer installed packages are reported as skew and users are steered to downgrade; embed goes stale on runtime-only releases
known_defects.mechanism: versionSkew compares with !== ; no lockstep release of stash with runtime packages
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the embedded/pinned versions can go stale relative to independently released runtime packages, or that the skew comparison treats newer versions as mismatches (downgrade advice).
